title: Consolidating 23 years of historical data from an irrigated subtropical rice breeding program in Uruguay
authors: Inés Rebollo; Sheila Scheffel; Pedro Blanco; Federico Molina; Sebastián Martínez; Gonzalo Carracelas; Ignacio Aguilar; Fernando Pérez de Vida; Juan Eduardo Rosas
decision: Consolidate historical rice breeding data; no testing policy
evaluation: Data consolidation, coverage and descriptive analyses
overlap: The intended Uruguay archive and its structure already published
proposed_addition: A decision replay on jointly observed yield and milling results, conditional on measurement availability
access_limitations: Publisher indexed methods and Table1 verified; direct publisher download403. Dataset README separately recovered by data team.
verification_notes: Published totals for separate traits cannot establish joint eligible candidate counts. Table1 does not state an archivewide yield moisture standard or explicit HR denominator.

authors: Sheila Scheffel; Bettina Lado; Fernando Pérez de Vida; Federico Molina; Juan D. Arbeláez; Juan E. Rosas
decision: Early parent selection and line advancement
inputs: Historical/current-year yield, trial/environment and pedigree for parent breeding values
budget: Single trial, all current-year trials, or current plus4 preceding years; no laboratory query budget

title: Multienvironment Models Increase Prediction Accuracy of Complex Traits in Advanced Breeding Lines of Rice
authors: Eliana Monteverde; Juan E. Rosas; Pedro Blanco; Fernando Pérez de Vida; Victoria Bonnecarrère; Gastón Quero; Lucía Gutierrez; Susan McCouch
decision: Genomic prediction and response to selection across environments
inputs: SNPs; multi-year yield, head recovery, milling yield, chalk and height

inputs: Marker genotypes and phenotyped training accessions; expected improvement

decision: Improve prediction of rice milling, appearance and cooking traits
inputs: Genome markers, trait-marker covariates and secondary quality traits
